lessons.trigger_condition: V405 added an autonomy status sidecar, but its temporary filename ended in a literal dollar sign instead of the shell PID token. Concurrent or overlapping status writers could therefore collide on one temporary path even though the final rename was atomic.
lessons.prevention_rule: Use the same process-qualified temporary-file convention already used by scheduler status and heartbeat writers: ${AUTONOMY_STATUS_FILE}.tmp.$$. Keep the final mv atomic, add a regression assertion for the exact PID-qualified token, and preserve the existing V405 bounded-autonomy, fail-closed and no-source-write safety boundaries.
validation_required: the only sync-watched functional path changed by the candidate is TABLET_SCHEDULED_UPDATE.sh
write_autonomy_status uses ${AUTONOMY_STATUS_FILE}.tmp.$$ and no literal .tmp.$ path remains
the existing scheduler unit test asserts the PID-qualified temp path
V405 daily update-check -> bounded autonomy -> scheduler reconcile order remains unchanged
manifest preflight and V400 self-test gates remain required before autonomy execution
source-code generation/rewrite, arbitrary command execution, Git writes and verification bypass remain forbidden
physical tablet runtime remains unverified until device-side evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V406 is a concurrency-safety correction only. It does not expand authority, change market/grade facts, persist precise location, track user behavior, alter model promotion gates, or permit autonomous source/Git writes.
